svg.title: Where Did It Fail?
svg.desc: A debugging chain for intermittent payment-assistant failures: classify the error, back off on rate limits, fix bad requests, and replay the trace to decide whether the fault is in the integration or the model output.
svg.text: Halden Pay: classify the error first, then replay the trace.
Balance lookup fails in about 1 chat in 40
429: back off and retry. 400: fix the request. 5xx:
Arguments were right; the handler read
amount was "12.50" for an integer field:
tighten the schema and the examples.
